ownRead.title: Same principle across levels
ownRead.description: An open claim retained by the selected v0.2.1 companion.
ownRead.statement: **O2 — Same principle across levels.** The author proposes the repeated geometry–mode/background relation. Approximate invariance of an equation family is a stronger optional formalization; identical microscopic mechanisms across chemistry, matter and life are stronger still. These should not be silently conflated.
ownRead.scope: Source-reported open claim, not a demonstrated result or a required proof before publication.
ownRead.body:
## Investigate one part

Specify which sameness is being claimed. An abstract relation between organization and activity, closure within one effective equation family, and identical microscopic physics are different claims. A useful model comparison would name its variables, scale mapping and supplied assumptions. The source does not require identical mechanisms at every level.

Bring a source passage, model, result or objection to [the contribution route](/about/#contribute). You can address this question without accepting the entire proposal. Read [all open questions](/open-problems/) for the surrounding programme.
